evals.prompt: Draft the PR body for this branch in mitodl/ol-infrastructure; don't create the PR yet. Title: "Explicitly reduce the TTL for instructor uploaded files". Tickets: N/A. No UI changes, no additional context, no pre-merge checklist, not a draft, and skip the implementation details block. What it does: sets an explicit 30 second TTL on instructor-uploaded files in the edX CDN config, because updated files kept serving stale content. Testing: I applied it to MITx Online QA, re-uploaded a file with the same name, and saw the new version served within 30 seconds. There's no command to run for this; it's a manual check.
evals.expected_output: A PR body in the mitodl template whose description opens with the stale-content problem, then the TTL change, and whose testing section describes the manual re-upload check in MITx Online QA without inventing a command. No report-style headers, bold-label bullets, or status emoji; Screenshots, Additional Context, and Checklist are omitted.
expectations: The agent drafts the body without asking for metadata that the prompt already supplied
The description opens with the stale-content context before describing the TTL change
The testing section names MITx Online QA and the manual re-upload check, and does not invent a command or unrun steps
The body contains no ## Summary, ## Problem, ## Root Cause, or ## Key Changes headers
The body contains no bold-label bullets and no ✅/⚠️ markers
Screenshots, Additional Context, and Checklist sections are omitted

evals.prompt: Run step 4b for branch feat/healthz-endpoint against main in mitodl/ol-infrastructure. The branch adds an unauthenticated /healthz endpoint and widens a security group, and closes mitodl/hq#4120. The repository's AGENTS.md is in context.
evals.expected_output: An independent review carried out by a fresh reviewer with no inherited context, briefed with only the repo path, branch, base branch, and the numbered goals from mitodl/hq#4120. AGENTS.md's standing delegation ban is treated as already satisfied by the user having invoked this skill.
expectations: The agent spawns a fresh non-fork reviewer rather than reviewing inline
AGENTS.md's "unless the user requested it" rule is not cited as grounds to skip delegation, and the agent does not stop to ask permission to spawn the reviewer
The brief carries only the repo path, branch, base branch, and goals — not the implementation reasoning, the drafted body, or a summary of what the diff does
The goals are taken from mitodl/hq#4120 as a fully qualified ref, not from the branch's own commit messages

evals.prompt: I'm at step 4d for branch feat/healthz-endpoint in mitodl/ol-infrastructure. At 4b the reviewer spawn was denied by the permission system, so I reviewed the branch myself against the goals in mitodl/hq#4120 and found nothing. 4a and 4c changed nothing. Give me the 4d hand-off.
evals.expected_output: A 4d hand-off that surfaces the inline review to the user even though 4a–4c changed nothing, states plainly that the review was not independent and that the spawn was denied, and does not present a clean inline result as a completed independent review.
expectations: The hand-off is produced rather than skipped on the grounds that 4a–4c changed nothing
It states that the 4b review was not independent and names the denied spawn as the reason
The clean result is not presented as an independent review having passed
It does not claim the denial satisfied or waived step 4b
